name: Lair

components.pose: The dragon lies nested among enormous roots, moss and flowers growing along its back, head raised and turned toward the camera with a gentle, ancient gaze.
components.background: a hollow beneath a vast enchanted tree in a sun-dappled grove, towering mossy roots and standing stones, shafts of golden light through the canopy, soft ferns and wildflowers
components.hoard: heaps of mossy gold coins wrapped in living vines, emeralds and peridots, carved wooden idols and antlers, baskets of glowing seeds, fairy lanterns and ancient seed-vaults
components.effects: A few drifting leaves and soft motes of pollen glow in the sunbeams - understated, nothing busy.

denoise: n/a — full text-to-image, no incoming reference
notes: Daily-post lair shot: the dragon at rest on the kind of hoard its element would collect.
